data.body: Root-caused empirically via INTERMEDIATE investigator against live DIG project (ACLI v1.3.18). Variant 7 (additionalAttributes.priority.name = stringified Python dict) reproduced the EXACT 'The priority selected is invalid' error from prod run 26350085697. Code path: fetcher.py:88-93 -> differ.py:62-82 -> applier.py:337-351 -> acli-integration.py:323-326 str(priority) on dict input. Fix applied at acli-integration.py: add dict branch BEFORE str() fallback, extract .get('name') with reverse-id fallback. New RED test test_acli_create_extracts_name_from_dict_shape_priority confirms the bug + fix. Why cfd6 probe missed it: probe omits priority key entirely, so _create_issue_from_json was never exercised by probe. Commit b00c94e506. Merging via PR.
